name: ScratchEye_1
short_caption: The robot lifts its right hand to gently rub near its eye as if tired or dealing with an itch, then returns to a neutral stand.
movement_description: The robot begins in a neutral standing posture, then raises its right arm, bending at the elbow to bring its closed hand up to its face. It tilts its head slightly downward and forward, performing a subtle rubbing motion near its right eye. After a brief pause, it lowers its arm smoothly back to its side while returning its head to a level, forward-facing position.
safety_notes: The right arm lifts in a compact trajectory close to the robot's face; no high-velocity sweeps or wide lateral clearance concerns.
